question: Who is the author of the book "India@2047: Charts Roadmap to Global Economic Leadership"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S.P. Sharma.**__

• **S.P. Sharma is the author of the book "India@2047: Charts Roadmap to Global Economic Leadership."**

• It emphasizes key initiatives like Make in India, IMEC, and digital innovation that are seen as crucial growth catalysts for India.
